requests.reply: {"t": [{"id":0, "text": "New Employee Onboarding Guide"}, {"id":1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id":2, "text": "This document guides you through what to do in order for the first 2 weeks ▶"}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "If you have any questions, you can ask Manager Joonho Byun in the HR team."}, {"id":1, "text": "Seojin Um will help you set up the development environment."}, {"id":2, "text": "Day one"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you come to work, first get your access card at the reception desk on the 1st floor."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access card you receive will be registered by Manager Byun Jun-ho." }, {"id": 1, "text": "The seats are next to the Dawn Team, and Um Seo-jin also sits in the same row." }, {"id": 2, "text": "Lunch is eaten with the team members."}]}
{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "The second day"}, {"id":1, "text": "On the second day, we spend the whole day on site."}, {"id":2, "text": "We observe the unloading work while wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "I do not speak to the workers who are working first."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The experience report is submitted to the team leader for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once confirmed, it will be passed on to Manager Byun Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id":0, "text": "New hires at MoaLogis go through a task list called 'Launchpad' in their first week."}, {"id":1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and joining the company messenger."}, {"id":2, "text": "Company-wide announcements and casual chat take place in the 'Hearth' channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Step 2 is to take the dispatch system guide training."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You will create a day's dispatch plan yourself as a guide."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not upload practice screens to Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't have to write a long report."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish all the stepping stones, you will start the practical work from the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The first practical work will be receiving a code review with Eom Seo-jin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Code review results will be shared in the Modakbul team channel."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byun Jun-ho." }, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, leave a brief comment on Modakbul to finish."}]}
